description: Suppose each ground name is supplied with deciding maximal antichains whose downward closures are ground sets, and each resulting positive-row code belongs to the ground set. For every ground-generic \(H\) and every \(x\in M[H]\) with \(x\subseteq\omega\), some \(b\in\mathcal C\) satisfies \((b,x)\in E_H\). The witness is the actual positive-row code of a name for \(x\).
